en: Black‑and‑white vintage street view showing a row of urban buildings with shops and a cinema named "Capitol" at the front, a 'Bahnhotel' (railway hotel) sign on the gabled building, and several pedestrians and cyclists along a fenced sidewalk above a lower roadway or rail cutting. At the right, a larger ornate corner building faces a square with an early motorbus and cars, and in the distant background a wooded hill with a tower or lookout on top. The caption at the bottom left reads "Radebeul‑West."
